nodes.label: Codel full logo (ink)
nodes.description: Full horizontal lockup (viewBox 671.68x117.31): the 'co' monogram followed by the slanted geometric letters d, e (three stacked bars) and l, reading 'codel'. Three paths, all filled charcoal #101411 (the same hex as the --bg token).
nodes.rationale: Ink variant for light grounds. Not used on the dark-first site's own surfaces; it exists for the declared but unswitched light theme and for print or partner use.
